sentences.text: Let the record of the trial Court be called.
Heard on I.A No.7140/2025, which is first application under Section 430 of BNSS for grant of suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant Mahesh.

Appellant has been convicted under sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years RI with fine of Rs.10000/-, 3 years RI with fine of Rs.10,000/-, 3 years RI with fine of Rs.10,000/- and 2 years RI with fine of Rs.10,000/- respectively with default stipulation.
Counsel for appellant submits that the appellant is already on bail and his jail sentence is suspended till 7.06.2025.
Considering the aforesaid, I.A No.7140/2025 is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant is suspended upon his/her depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his/her appearance before the Registry of this Court on 19.08.2025 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) V. JUDGE 2 CRA-5082-2025 MK Mahesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164708832/
